noAccessBody: Your role does not include the permission “billing:read” for this product or tenant.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Plans with prices and entitlements. Plans in use can be deactivated but not deleted.
plans.formDescription: Prices are stored in minor units (cents). Studio does not process payments.
plans.name: Name
plans.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, “_” and “-”, starting with a letter, e.g. pro.
plans.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, “_” or “-”, starting with a letter (at most 63 characters).
plans.trialDaysHelp: 0 to 365. New subscriptions start in the trial.
plans.trialInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 365.
plans.activeHelp: Only active plans can be chosen for new subscriptions.
plans.deleteBody: The plan {{name}} is removed. Plans used by a subscription cannot be deleted; deactivate them instead.
plans.emptyBody: Create a plan with prices and entitlements, then subscribe tenants to it.

prices.title: Prices
prices.help: Without prices, or with only zero prices, the plan is free.
prices.free: No prices: this plan is free.
prices.amountInvalid: Enter an amount with at most the currency’s decimal places.
prices.currencyInvalid: Use a three-letter ISO 4217 code, e.g. EUR.
prices.providerPriceIdHelp: Optional, e.g. the Stripe price id.

entitlements.title: Entitlements
entitlements.editorHelp: Features are on or off. Limits set the quota of a usage meter per period; leave the value empty for unlimited.
entitlements.name: Feature name
entitlements.nameInvalid: Lowercase letters, digits, “_” and “.”, starting with a letter.
entitlements.limitInvalid: Enter a number of 0 or more.
entitlements.effectiveDescription: The plan’s entitlements (while trialing, active or past due) merged with the tenant’s overrides.
entitlements.overridesDescription: Overrides replace single entitlement keys for this tenant. Saving replaces all overrides.

provider.title: Payment provider
provider.noCardData: Studio never asks for card or bank details. Payments happen only on the provider’s hosted page.
provider.unknown: The provider configuration is not visible to you (it needs the permission “platform:settings” or “product:manage”).

explain.manual: Payment is collected outside Axentra. Subscriptions are created directly and their status is set by an operator.
explain.fake: Deterministic test provider without network access. Paid plans go through a simulated checkout.
explain.stripe: Paid plans go through Stripe Checkout; Stripe webhooks update the subscriptions.
explain.other: Reported by the server; Studio has no description for this provider.

provider.checkoutHosted: Available for paid plans: Studio opens the provider’s hosted page.
provider.checkoutLive: Not offered: live payments are on. Use your product’s own checkout.
provider.checkoutNone: Not needed: subscriptions are created directly.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Subscriptions of all tenants, newest first.
subscriptions.openDescription: Open a tenant’s subscription and entitlements, also when it has no subscription yet.
subscriptions.emptyBody: Open a tenant above to subscribe it to a plan.

tenant.title: Tenant billing
tenant.description: Subscription and entitlements of this tenant.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.noneBody: Subscribe the tenant to a plan.
subscription.subscribeDescription: Free plans, and any plan with the manual provider, start right away.
subscription.changeDescription: Current plan: {{plan}}. There is no proration.
subscription.statusDescription: Manual provider: record what happened outside Axentra. Current status: {{status}}.
subscription.cancelScheduled: The subscription ends at the end of the period
subscription.canceledNotice: The latest subscription is canceled. Subscribe the tenant again to start a new one.
subscription.endsNotice: Ends at the end of the period on {{date}}.
subscription.pastDueNotice: Payment is overdue. The entitlements stay in effect as a grace period.
subscription.incompleteNotice: Waiting for the checkout to be completed at the provider.
subscription.stripeManaged: Plan changes of Stripe subscriptions are made in Stripe; the webhook updates Axentra.
subscription.manualPaid: Manual provider: collect the payment outside Axentra.

cancelAtEnd.title: Cancel at period end?
cancelAtEnd.body: The subscription to {{plan}} stays active until {{date}} and then ends.

cancelNow.title: Cancel now?
cancelNow.body: The subscription to {{plan}} ends immediately and its entitlements stop. This cannot be undone.

resume.title: Resume subscription?
resume.body: The scheduled cancellation of {{plan}} is withdrawn.

checkout.explain: This plan is paid. Studio creates a checkout session; payment details are entered only on the provider’s hosted page.
checkout.unavailable: This paid plan needs a checkout, which the server does not offer here.
checkout.liveBlocked: Live payments are on. Studio does not start real-money checkouts; use your product’s checkout.
checkout.changeNeedsCheckout: Switching to this paid plan needs a checkout with the provider. Cancel the current subscription and subscribe again.
checkout.readyBody: Open the hosted checkout page of {{provider}} to complete the subscription. The subscription stays incomplete until the provider confirms it.

info.trialDays: New subscriptions start in “Trial” and get the plan’s entitlements. With the manual provider, a trial ends only when the operator’s scheduled billing task runs.
info.providerPriceId: With Stripe, enter the id of the price you created in Stripe. Axentra uses it to map Stripe’s subscription updates back to this plan.
info.status: Trial, Active and Past due grant the plan’s entitlements; Past due is a grace period. Incomplete waits for the checkout at the provider. Canceled is final.
info.entitlements: Without a subscription in Trial, Active or Past due, the tenant gets only its overrides. Overrides stay when the plan changes or the subscription ends.
